doc.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

title: Draft deferments and a bandmates' reunion
summary: Friends in the Shaw Navy band, and a reunion at the Commodore Hotel.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: The only deferment was just physical.

4F, if you were 4F, yeah. See at that time we were all — now Gozzo, two or three guys from Claude’s band got into the Artie Shaw Navy band and they didn’t have it easy, they were in the Pacific being shot at you know. But they survived. What a reunion — he

joined Woody’s band right after he got out of the Navy, and I joined this McKinley band and we were working the Commodore Hotel and they came in town to play the Paramount. Their band finished early, they call came over where we were, what a reunion.
I guess, wow. Wish to have that on film.
